title: Welcome to your workspace
subtitle: A calm view of your farms, boundaries and data readiness.
statFarmsHint: Number of farms in your organization
statFieldsHint: Total number of fields across farms
statAreaHint: Sum of farm total areas in hectares
dbGeodesic: Field areas use geodesic WGS84 math (PostGIS + PyProj).
setupDesc: Nothing here yet — four short steps take you from blank workspace to a data passport.
step1: Create a farm — a country, timezone and currency context for your fields.
step2: Draw or paste a field boundary (GeoJSON) — areas are computed geodesically.
step4: Open the Data Passport to see what analyses are ready.
quickActionsDesc: Jump straight into the next useful step.
passportNeedField: Data Passport — add a field first
howDesc: Decision support, not an autonomous agronomist.
howFarms: holds boundaries and versions — every boundary change is versioned, and areas are recomputed geodesically.
howObservations: runs ingestion jobs against the synthetic fixtures and the real Open-Meteo reanalysis archive, or imports your CSV records and CHIRPS rasters — every source keeps its own honest evidence label.
howPassport: is the honesty layer: what data exists, how fresh it is, and which analyses are actually available.
